story:
Coyote, a clever, animal-like trickster and creator, appears throughout many traditional stories. In one account, a primal being floating on endless waters is joined by Coyote, and together they sing the world into being. After people are created, Coyote vows to bring evil into the world; the primal being orders the people to destroy him, but Coyote outwits them with trickery, forcing the being to admit Coyote's power equals his own. In another tale, Coyote saves the world from ten evil moons that had caused endless winter. In another, after creating all the animals, Coyote calls a council to decide what qualities humans should have; when the animals argue over whose traits to use, Coyote mocks them and secretly destroys the human models the other animals had shaped overnight, leaving only his own model to come alive. In another story, while a creator shapes beings from clay, Coyote tries to do the same but keeps laughing and fails; accused of laughing, he denies it, telling the world's first lie.

In another myth, Coyote's grandson disobeys his mother, enters a forbidden cave, and is transformed into a giant, hairy mountain sheep. Two sky-dwelling brothers kill and eat him. Coyote, aided by a spider, a bird, and a wolf's counsel, hides water, sets a trap, and strikes the brothers with a hot stone so the spider can catch and kill them. Returning to his grandson's remains, Coyote finds them gone and realizes the boy has become the first horse.

Elsewhere, Coyote repeatedly fails to catch fish until his own excrement begins speaking, giving him detailed instructions for fishing, which he then follows successfully. In a related story, a trickster figure climbs a tree to spin a web like a spider but only leaves behind clumps of hair, which become a lichen. In a creation account, Coyote and another transformer reshape the earth's mountains and valleys and turn ancient magical beings into animals, while virtuous descendants become people. In an emergence story, Coyote guides the first humans up from the underworld to the earth, while another creature continues downward, and Coyote alone remains above with the people.
